# Otter.ai Pricing

> Otter.ai has four plans: Basic (free), Pro, Business, and Enterprise. All prices are in USD, per billed user.
> Source: https://otter.ai/pricing. Last updated: 2026-10-27.

## Key facts

- Self-serve plans (Basic, Pro, Business) have no minimum number of users. You can buy a single seat.
- Workspace sizes are maximums: Basic up to 5 members, Pro up to 5 billed users, Business up to 25 billed users, Enterprise unlimited.
- Annual billing costs about 50% less than monthly on Pro and 33% less on Business.
- SSO and SCIM are only available on Enterprise (100-user minimum license); they are not on Basic, Pro, or Business.
- Transcription minutes reset monthly and do not roll over.

## Plans at a glance

| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing | Max workspace size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | Free | Free | 5 members |
| Pro | $16.99/user/month | $8.33/user/month ($99.99/user/year) | 5 billed users |
| Business | $30/user/month | $19.99/user/month, billed annually | 25 billed users |
| Enterprise | Contact sales | Contact sales | Unlimited |

## Basic plan (free)

For those who want to give it a try.

- Basic price: Free
- Basic max workspace size: 5 members
- Basic transcription: 300 minutes per user per month, shared across meetings, recordings, and imports
- Basic max length per conversation: 30 minutes
- Basic file imports: 3 lifetime per user
- Basic concurrent meetings: 1
- Basic AI Chat: 20 queries per user per month (3 per conversation)
- Basic custom AI meeting templates: 5 meetings per user
- Basic conversation history: 25 most recent
- Basic custom vocabulary: 5 terms
- Basic exports: mp3, txt
- Basic Salesforce/HubSpot sync: not included
- Basic support: standard email support
- Basic features: joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet; live transcription; speaker identification; multi-language support; iOS and Android apps; Otter MCP server

## Pro plan

For individuals and small teams. Includes everything in Basic.

- Pro price: $16.99/user/month billed monthly, or $8.33/user/month billed annually ($99.99/user/year)
- Pro max workspace size: 5 billed users
- Pro transcription: 1,200 minutes per user per month, shared across meetings, recordings, and imports
- Pro max length per conversation: 90 minutes
- Pro file imports: 10 per user per month
- Pro concurrent meetings: 2
- Pro AI Chat: 50 queries per user per month
- Pro custom AI meeting templates: 15 meetings per user
- Pro conversation history: unlimited
- Pro custom vocabulary: 100 names + 100 other terms per user, and the same per team
- Pro exports: mp3, txt, pdf, docx, srt
- Pro Salesforce/HubSpot sync: 1 user
- Pro support: standard email support
- Pro also includes: advanced AI meeting templates and workflows, unlimited storage, taggable speakers, advanced search, Zapier integration

## Business plan

For medium-sized teams. Includes everything in Pro.

- Business price: $30/user/month billed monthly, or $19.99/user/month billed annually
- Business promotion: first-time subscribers on monthly billing get 20% off for the first 3 months ($24/user/month)
- Business max workspace size: 25 billed users
- Business transcription: unlimited meeting and recording minutes; imported files limited to 6,000 minutes per user per month
- Business max length per conversation: 4 hours
- Business file imports: unlimited
- Business concurrent meetings: 3
- Business AI Chat: 200 queries per user per month
- Business custom AI meeting templates: 30 meetings per user
- Business conversation history: unlimited
- Business custom vocabulary: 200 names + 200 other terms per user; 800 names + 800 other terms per team
- Business exports: mp3, txt, pdf, docx, srt, bulk export
- Business Salesforce/HubSpot sync: 5 users
- Business support: prioritized
- Business also includes: custom AI workflows, enhanced admin features (activity logs, usage analytics, and more)

## Enterprise plan

For large teams and companies. Includes everything in Business.

- Enterprise price: contact sales ([schedule a demo](https://otter.ai/enterprise))
- Enterprise max workspace size: unlimited
- Enterprise transcription: unlimited meeting and recording minutes; imported files limited to 6,000 minutes per user per month
- Enterprise max length per conversation: 4 hours
- Enterprise file imports: unlimited
- Enterprise concurrent meetings: 3
- Enterprise AI Chat: 200 queries per user per month
- Enterprise custom AI meeting templates: unlimited
- Enterprise Salesforce/HubSpot sync: unlimited users
- Enterprise support: prioritized, plus a Customer Success Program
- Enterprise SSO and SCIM: included, 100-user minimum license required
- Enterprise also includes: unlimited custom AI workflows, Otter Sales Notetaker, custom integrations (CRM, dialers), domain capture, enterprise-grade security and controls, HIPAA compliance (add-on), Otter API and webhooks, video replay for Zoom and Google Meet

## Student and teacher discount

Individual students and teachers with a .edu email get 20% off Pro: $13.59/month billed monthly, or $6.67/month billed annually ($79.99/year).

## Payment methods

Credit and debit cards on otter.ai, or in-app purchase through the Apple App Store or Google Play. PayPal is not supported.
